questions.question: If cosec θ = 17/8, then what is the value of cos θ?
questions.solution:
∵ cosec θ = 17/8

1/cosec θ = Sin θ = 8/17

cos θ = √[1 - (Sin θ)²] = √(1 - 64/289)

∴ cos θ = 15/17

questions.question: If a shopkeeper sells an item at Rs. 4200 which is marked as Rs 4800, then what is the discount (in %) that he is offering?
questions.solution:
Discount price = 4800 - 4200 = Rs 600

Discount % = (600/4800) × 100 = 100/8 = 12.5%

∴ The discount that he is offering = 12.5%

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (4, -3) in the line y = 1?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/188a9ba7973fafebf98431ca58d3d5ec306d2a972f9260b53047d305d67f7dd4.png] 

Line y = 1 is parallel to the x axis and therefore the x-coordinate of the reflection of point will stay same

And on the other side this line is perpendicular to Y axis and therefore the shortest distance between the point and the line is = 1 - (-3) = 4

The reflection will be at same distance i.e. 4 and hence its y coordinate will be 1 + 4 = 5

∴ The reflection of the point (4, -3) in the line y = 1 is (4, 5)

questions.question: What is the ratio of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of Country E to Total of GDPs of countries A, C and F taken together?
questions.solution:
∵ GDP of A = 30, GDP of C = 70 and GDP of F = 50

Total GDP of A, C and F = 150

GDP of E = 90

Respective ratio = 90/150 = 3 : 5

∴ The ratio of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of Country E to Total of GDPs of countries A, C and F taken together = 3 : 5

questions.question: If the combined GDP of the six countries has grown by 50% in the last decade, then what was their combined annual Gross Domestic Product (in billion USD) before 10 years?
questions.solution:
Total GDP of All countries = 30 + 70 + 100 + 90 + 20 + 50 = 360

Let GDP before 10 years = X

This has grown by 50% in 10 years

X + 0.5X = 360

⇒ 1.5X = 360

⇒ X = 360/1.5

⇒ X = 240

∴ combined annual Gross Domestic Product (in billion USD) before 10 years = $ 240 billon

questions.question: A trader buys 800 kg of tomatoes for Rs 7200. 10% tomatoes are damaged in transportation. At what rate (Rs/kg) should he sell the rest to earn 30% profit?
questions.solution:
∵ Cost Price of 800 kg of tomatoes = Rs. 7200

Price of 1 Kg of tomatoes = 7200/800 = Rs. 9

Damaged tomatoes = 10% of 800kg

Damaged tomatoes = 80

Undamaged tomatoes to be sold = 720

Let selling price is ‘S’/Kg

Now, Total selling price of 720 Kg tomatoes = 720 × S

Profit is 30%, this means

(720S - 7200)/7200 = 0.3

⇒ 720S = 2160 + 7200

⇒ S = 9360/720 = Rs. 13

∴ Sell the rest tomatoes at Rs. 13/kg

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles ΔABC and ΔPQR are 121 sq cms and 64 sq cms respectively. If PQ = 12 cm, what is the length (in cm) of AB?
questions.solution:
Area of a triangle is = 1/2 × (Base) × (Altitude)

All sides the similar triangles are in same ratio and hence their areas will also be in the same ratio.

So (PQ/AB) × (Ratio of altitudes) = Area of PQR / Area of ABC

[∵ Ratio of altitudes = PQ/AB]

(12/AB)² = 64/121

AB = 11 × 12/8 = 16.5 cm

∴ The length of AB = 16.5 cm

questions.question: A student has to secure 35% marks to pass in a Subject. If he gets 82 marks, fails by 23 marks. What are the maximum marks of the Subject?
questions.solution:
Students get 82 marks and fails by 23 marks

Required marks needed to pass = 82 + 23 = 105 marks

∵ secure 35% marks to pass in a Subject

Let the total marks be T

Then, 35% of T = 105

⇒ 0.35 × T = 105

⇒ T = 300

∴ The maximum marks of the Subject = 300

questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of a rhombus if the lengths of its diagonals are 25 cm and 20 cm?
questions.solution:
Area of Rhombus = 1/2 × (Product of diagonals) = (25 × 20)/2 = 250

∴ Area of Rhombus = 250 cm

3 numbers whose average is 112, the first number is 1/6th the sum of the other two numbers. What is the first number?
questions.solution:
∵ Average of three numbers is 112

This means sum of 3 numbers is = 112 × 3 = 336

Let the first number be X

Then X = (1/6) × (Sum of other two numbers) = (1/6) × (336 - X)

⇒ X + X/6 = 336/6

⇒ X = 336/7 = 48

∴ First number = 48

questions.question: The flight fare between two cities is increased in the ratio 11 : 13. What is the increase (in Rs) in the fare, if the original fare was Rs 12100?
questions.solution:
Let New price be N

Original price = Rs. 12100

12100 : N = 11 : 13

On cross multiplication we get,

N = (13/11) × 12100 = Rs 14300

Increase in price = 14300 - 12100 = Rs. 2200

∴ The increase (in Rs) in the fare = Rs. 2200

questions.question: If 5x - (1/2) × (2x - 7) = 5.5, then what is the value of x?
In what ratio does the point T(x, 0) divide the segment joining the points S(5, 1) and U(-1, -2)?
questions.solution:
According to the section formula, if a point P(x, y) that lies on a line segment AB joining points A(x₁, y₁) and B(x₂, y₂), divides the line in the ratio m∶ n, then the coordinates of P can be computed as,

Coordinates of P = (x, y) = [(mx₂ + nx₁)/(m + n)], [(my₂ + ny₁)/(m + n)]

Let the point T(x, 0) divide the segment joining S(5, 1) and U(-1, -2) in the ratio m∶ n, then,

(x, 0) = [(-m + 5n)/(m + n)], [(-2m + n)/(m + n)]

⇒ 0 = (-2m + n)/(m + n)

⇒ -2m + n = 0

⇒ 2m = n

⇒ m/n = 1/2

∴ Point T(x, 0) divides the given line segment in ratio 1 ∶ 2

The sum of a number and 4 times its reciprocal is 5. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be X

According to the condition,

X + 4/X = 5

⇒ X² + 4 = 5X

⇒ X² - 5X + 4 = 0

⇒ X = 1, 4

∴ Only possible option is (1)

questions.question: The 3rd and 8th term of an arithmetic progression is -13 and 2 respectively. What is the 14th term?
questions.solution:
If a is the first term and d is the common difference then the third term of the AP is given by

a + 2d = -13 ----(1)

And 8th term is given by

a + 7d = 2 ----(2)

Subject (1) from (2)

5d = 15

⇒ d = 3

Put in equation (1)

a = -13 - 6 = -19

14th term will be given as

a + 13d = -19 + 13 × 3 = -19 + 39 = 20

∴ The 14th term = 20

questions.question: If the amount received at the end of 2nd and 3rd year as Compound Interest on a certain Principal is Rs. 2100, and Rs. 2268 respectively, what is the rate (in %) of interest?
questions.solution:
Let the Principle is P and interest rate is R

Amount at the end of Second year = P(1 + R/100)² = 2100 ----(1)

Amount at the end of third year = P(1 + R/100)³ = 2268 ----(2)

Divide (2) by (1)

[P(1 + R/100)³]/ [P(1 + R/100)²] = 2268/2100

⇒ 1 + R/100 = 2268/2100

⇒ 1 + R/100 = 27/25

⇒ R = (2/25) × 100

⇒ R = 8%

∴ The rate of interest = 8%

questions.question: A spaceship travels at 810 km/hr. How many meters does it travel in 1/5th of a second?
questions.solution:
Speed of spaceship = 810km/hr

Distance covered in 1 second = 810/3600 km = 810000/3600 m = 225 m

Distance covered in 1/5 of the second = 225/5 = 45 m

∴ Distance traveled by spaceship in 1/5th of a second = 45 m

A can do 1/3rd of a job in 3 days and B can do half of the job in 9 days. If they working together, then in how many days can they finish half of the job?
questions.solution:
Let the work be x

Then Work done by A in one day = (1/3)(x/3) = x/9

Work done by B in one day = (1/2)(x/9) = x/18

Work done by both in one day together = x × ((1/18) + (1/9)) = x × (1/6) = x/6

Time taken to finish total work i.e. x = 6

Time taken to finish Half of the work = 3 days

∴ They can finish half of the job in 3 days
